UserPublicProfile.title: UserPublicProfile
UserPublicProfile.description: Publicly scoped non-PII user profile metadata and initial practice-seed tracking.

displayName.description: User display name shown in the UI.

seededPractice.description: Whether initial practice journal records have been seeded for this user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile was last updated.

UserPrivateInfo.title: UserPrivateInfo
UserPrivateInfo.description: Isolated private PII and login tracking metadata for the authenticated user.

lastLoginAt.description: Server timestamp of the most recent login.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the most recent private record update.

JournalRecord.title: JournalRecord
JournalRecord.description: A daily one-line journal entry belonging to a single user (active or trashed).

ownerId.description: UID of the user who owns this journal record.

recordedAt.description: Immutable journal date timestamp in epoch milliseconds.

trashedAt.description: Server timestamp when moved to trash, or null when active.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-only user profile document tracking non-PII display info and seed flag.

/users/{userId}/private/{docId}.description: Isolated private PII document (docId: info) containing verified email and login timestamp.

/users/{userId}/entries/{entryId}.description: User-owned journal entries (both active and trashed records).
